name: Medallion
description: Medallion is a modern healthcare operations platform that automates provider credentialing, licensing, and payer enrollment. Built with a developer-first API approach, Medallion combines software automation with a managed services team to handle the end-to-end credentialing lifecycle. The platform is particularly popular with digital health companies, telehealth providers, and fast-growing healthcare organizations that need to scale provider networks quickly.
short_description: Modern credentialing platform automating provider licensing, payer enrollment, and primary source verification for digital health companies.
one_liner: End-to-end credentialing automation with API-first infrastructure

pricing.notes: Medallion offers both software-only and managed services options. Pricing varies significantly based on services needed, volume, and whether using API/platform access. Volume discounts available. Implementation typically included.

company.description: Medallion is a venture-backed healthcare operations platform founded to modernize provider credentialing and licensing through automation and API-first infrastructure.

compliance.notes: Medallion maintains SOC 2 Type II certification and is HIPAA compliant. While not NCQA CVO accredited themselves, they work with NCQA-accredited partners for delegated credentialing needs.

faqs.question: How much does Medallion credentialing cost?
faqs.answer: Medallion pricing varies by service: Credentialing runs $150-300 per provider/month, new state licenses cost $500-1,500 per license, and payer enrollment is $200-500 per enrollment. API platform access has custom pricing. Volume discounts are available, and implementation is typically included in the subscription.

faqs.question: How fast can Medallion complete credentialing?
faqs.answer: Medallion typically completes initial credentialing in 7-21 days, with primary source verification done in 24-48 hours. New state licenses take 4-12 weeks depending on the state, and payer enrollment ranges from 30-90 days. Re-credentialing can be completed in 3-7 days.

faqs.question: Does Medallion have an API for credentialing?
faqs.answer: Yes, Medallion is built API-first and offers a comprehensive REST API for programmatic access to all credentialing functions. This includes webhooks for real-time status updates, making it ideal for digital health companies that want to integrate credentialing into their own platforms and workflows.

faqs.question: Who uses Medallion for credentialing?
faqs.answer: Medallion is popular with digital health companies and telehealth platforms including Cerebral, Headway, Wheel, Transcarent, Lyra Health, and Quartet Health. It's particularly well-suited for fast-growing organizations that need to scale provider networks quickly and want modern API-based infrastructure.
